business_model.claim: StealthGas owns and operates a fleet of LPG carriers that provide international seaborne transportation services, carrying petroleum gas products in liquefied form including propane, butane, butadiene, isopropane, propylene and vinyl chloride monomer.
quotes: We own a fleet of LPG carriers providing international seaborne transportation services to LPG producers and users.

Our LPG carriers carry various petroleum gas products in liquefied form, including propane, butane, butadiene, isopropane, propylene and vinyl chloride monomer, which are all byproducts of the production of crude oil and natural gas.

business_model.claim: As of December 31, 2025 the fleet comprised 29 LPG carriers including one JV vessel, and as of April 1, 2026 it comprised 28 LPG carriers including one JV vessel with a total capacity of approximately 334,118 cubic meters.
quotes: As of December 31, 2025, we had a fleet of 29 LPG carriers, including one JV vessel.
As of April 1, 2026, our fleet is composed of 28 LPG carriers, including one JV Vessel, with a total capacity of approximately 334,118 cubic meters (cbm).

business_model.claim: Customers are LPG producers (national, major and independent energy companies and energy traders) and industrial users of those products; in 2025 three largest customers accounted for 34.1% of revenues.
quotes: Principal charterers include producers of LPG products, such as national, major and other independent energy companies and energy traders, and industrial users of those products.
For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, our three largest customers accounted for 34.1% and 32.3%, respectively, of our revenues.

business_model.claim: Revenue is earned through three charter types: time charters (fixed daily rate over a term), bareboat charters (fixed rate with charterer bearing all operating and voyage costs), and spot/voyage charters (fixed amount per cargo); no vessels were on bareboat charter as of April 1, 2026 and none have been since mid-2022.
quotes: Under a time charter, the charterer pays a fixed rate per day over the term of the charter
Under a voyage charter, we agree to transport a specified cargo from a loading port to a discharging port for a fixed amount.
We have not employed any vessels under bareboat charter since the middle of 2022.

business_model.claim: Total revenues were $173,161,478 in 2025, $167,262,185 in 2024, and $143,527,769 in 2023, driven by fleet size, voyage days, and daily charter hire rates.
quotes: Our voyage revenues are driven primarily by the number and size of the vessels in our fleet, the number of voyage days during which our vessels generate revenues and the amount of daily charter hire that our vessels earn under charters

business_model.claim: The average Time Charter Equivalent daily rate was $15,022 in 2025, $16,080 in 2024, and $12,334 in 2023, while fleet utilization was 96.7%, 97.3%, and 98.8% respectively.

Fleet utilization(6) | 98.8% | 97.3% | 96.7%

In terms of charter coverage as of April 1, 2026, we had 49% of the available calendar days fixed under period charters for 2026 and 17% for 2027.

business_model.claim: Voyage expenses (port, canal charges, bunker/fuel, carbon allowances, commissions) were $20,433,872 in 2025, incurred only when vessels operate on voyage or spot charters; vessel operating expenses (crew, insurance, maintenance, spares, tonnage taxes) were $52,980,264 in 2025.
quotes: Voyage expenses | 20,433,872
Vessels' operating expenses | 52,980,264
Voyage expenses include port and canal charges, bunker (fuel oil) expenses, carbon allowances under the EU ETS scheme and commissions.

Vessel operating expenses include crew wages and related costs, the cost of insurance, expenses for repairs and maintenance, the cost of spares and consumable stores, tonnage taxes and other miscellaneous expenses.

business_model.claim: Depreciation of $25,252,476 in 2025 is calculated on a straight-line basis over 30-year estimated useful lives at $350 per light weight ton residual value, making it a major non-cash cost driver.
quotes: Depreciation | 25,252,476

We depreciate our vessels on a straight-line basis over their estimated useful lives, determined to be 30 years from the date of their initial delivery from the shipyard in the case of our LPG carriers.
Residual values used in depreciation calculations are based on $350 per light weight ton.

business_model.claim: The company is managed by Stealth Maritime, a related party controlled by the Vafias family, which charges a fixed fee of $440 per vessel per day for vessels on voyage or time charters, $125 per day for bareboat vessels, and 1.25% of gross freight, demurrage and charter hire collected.
quotes: We are managed by Stealth Maritime, a privately owned company controlled by other members of the Vafias family, of which our Chief Executive Officer is a member.
we pay Stealth Maritime a fixed management fee of $440 per vessel operating under a voyage or time charter per day
